hero.subtitle: Certified professional drone operators, based in Cosne-sur-Loire, Nièvre.

story.title: Who are we?
story.p1: Meridian Synergy was founded in 2026, driven by the acceleration of the professional drone sector and the harmonisation of the European regulatory framework (EU Regulation 2019/947). These developments open new opportunities for certified operators able to work in demanding sectors with state-of-the-art equipment.
story.p2: Based in Cosne-sur-Loire, in Nièvre, we built our business to meet the concrete needs of local stakeholders: local authorities, farmers, winegrowers, industrial companies and infrastructure managers. A rich territory where professional drones make a real difference.

v1.title: Reliability and responsiveness
v1.desc: Every mission is prepared with rigour: site analysis, flight plan, regulatory coordination. Quotes within 24 hours, rapid deployment across the whole area.

v2.title: Local roots
v2.desc: Based in Nièvre, we know the territory, local constraints and its stakeholders. We favour direct, lasting relationships.

v3.title: Cutting-edge technology
v3.desc: Latest-generation DJI fleet — Matrice 4TD and Agras T100 — for the best performance in thermal inspection, mapping and crop spraying.

v4.title: Regulatory compliance
v4.desc: Certified A1/A2/A3, CATS (DGAC Specific category), certiphyto and certiBiocide — all our operations comply with the applicable European and French framework.

s1.title: Purpose
s1.p1: These Terms of Sale (ToS) govern the conditions under which Meridian Synergy SAS (SIREN 101 847 895, 2 rue des Cages, 58200 Saint-Père, France) sells access to its SaaS platform accessible at app.meridian-synergy.com (hereinafter 'the Service').
s1.p2: Any subscription to the Service implies full and unreserved acceptance of these ToS. They take precedence over any contrary conditions of the purchaser unless agreed in writing in advance.

s2.title: Pricing
s2.p1: Access to the Service is billed on the basis of two cumulative components, expressed excluding VAT:
s2.item1: Essential plan: €10 excl. VAT / month / company — covers basic access to the platform, regardless of the number of users
s2.item2: Per seat: €5 excl. VAT / month / active user — a user is considered active if they have performed at least one action in the calendar month
s2.p2: Prices may change. Any pricing change is communicated to clients by email with a minimum notice of 30 days before taking effect.

s3.title: Free trial
s3.p1: Every new account benefits from a 3 (three) calendar month free trial starting from the account creation date, with full access to all features. No credit card is required during the trial period.
s3.p2: At the end of the trial period, access to the Service is suspended unless the company subscribes to a paid plan. Data is retained for 30 days after the trial ends before permanent deletion.

s4.title: Billing and payment
s4.p1: Billing is monthly, in arrears. Payment is made by automatic debit via the Stripe payment platform. The subscription is tacitly renewed each month.
s4.p2: Invoices are available for download in the account administration panel. They are issued in euros, excl. VAT. Applicable VAT is shown separately in accordance with current regulations.

s5.title: VAT
s5.p1: Prices are quoted excluding taxes. French VAT at the applicable rate applies to taxable customers established in France. For customers established in another EU Member State, the customer's country VAT applies in accordance with electronic services localisation rules.
s5.p2: Non-EU customers benefit from a VAT exemption. Any customer wishing to benefit from intra-Community VAT reverse charge must provide their valid intra-Community VAT number at the time of subscription.

s6.title: Cancellation
s6.p1: The subscription may be cancelled at any time by the User from their administration panel, with no fees or penalties. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current monthly period: no further access is granted beyond that date.

s7.title: Refunds
s7.p1: In accordance with SaaS industry practice and to the extent permitted by applicable regulations, no pro-rata refund is granted for cancellations made during a monthly period.
s7.p2: In the event of a billing error demonstrably attributable to Meridian Synergy, a credit note or refund will be issued within 15 business days of the error being identified.

s8.title: Late payment and suspension
s8.p1: In the event of non-payment, the Publisher sends a payment reminder by email on the due date. If payment is not made within 7 days of the reminder, access to the Service may be suspended. Data is retained during this suspension period.
s8.p2: If payment is not regularised within 30 days of suspension, the Publisher reserves the right to terminate the account and delete the associated data, after a final warning by email.

s9.title: Governing law
s9.p1: These ToS are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, an amicable solution will be sought first.
